name: zopt_get_throttle_mode
description: zOpt::GetThrottleMode reads the throttle bit from the shared game-control options word.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zGame options source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x407e50 validates returning bit 0 of ZOPT_GAME_CONTROL_OPTIONS.
The native smoke verifies both set and clear reads through the throttle option path.
